integrity: Exact proof uses beta moments, gamma recurrence/asymptotics, a unique monotone counting root, and harmonic rearrangement bounds; standalone finite calculations are auxiliary only. Literature comparison is not independent publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the explicitly normalized bounded two-frequency radial symbol on standard weighted Bergman A^2_alpha, alpha>-1, tau>0 and 0<b<1/(1+tau). The small-modulation condition is sufficient, not claimed necessary. No conclusion is made for larger amplitudes, nonradial symbols, incommensurable multifrequency symbols, or arbitrary radial doubling weights.
title: Log-periodic Weyl counting with bounded remainder for a Bergman Toeplitz commutator
